recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for this issue unless a future OO decision changes the binding strength or value set for the valueQuantity slice itself.
issue_request: FHIR-40505 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request for R5 reporting that the UCUM binding on Observation.component.value[x] incorrectly constrained valueCodeableConcept and should apply only to valueQuantity.
initial_application: No prior reconcile commit existed on the combined branch. The original source application appears to be git commit 0c05783eb5c324f149285a686a68a2b84a87513c, subject "40505", which moved the binding from generic Observation.component.value[x] to Observation.component.valueQuantity and is contained in the v5.0.0 tag.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread documents the validation failure for a body-position valueCodeableConcept component when the generic choice element inherited the UCUM binding, and the 2023-02-28 OO minutes record the persuasive motion that UCUM should only be on valueQuantity. Later Vital Signs cleanup, including FHIR-47136-related refactoring, converted the profile to the current Observation.component.value[x]:valueQuantity slice representation without reintroducing a generic binding.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current source has an unbound generic Observation.component.value[x] element and a dedicated Observation.component.value[x]:valueQuantity slice typed as Quantity with a UCUM value set binding.

related_jiras.note: Later Vital Signs profile cleanup refactored component value slicing and preserved the FHIR-40505 outcome by keeping the UCUM binding on the Quantity-specific slice rather than on the generic choice element.
